rule_or_requirement: A route choice must preserve valid completion and faster lap time from a common visual state, not infer benefit from unmatched full-episode paths.
observable_information: Frozen safe/fast pixel actions and private decision count; evaluation-only matched completion and trajectories.
allowed_action_or_state_change: After 50 identical mode-switch decisions, select the fast pixel action for the remainder; no simulator or map/seed input.
expected_success_endpoint: At least one repaired 5044 failure, all 5047 successes preserved, >=50 post-prefix action changes, zero invalid actions and identical prefix actions.
control: Exact frozen visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 on the same six consumed TRAIN cells.
falsifier: No changed actions, no repaired failure, lost reference finish, invalid action or prefix mismatch.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Two arms on tracks 1-3 x consumed TRAIN seeds 5044 and 5047, twelve episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU local diagnostic capped at 1,200 seconds and 2,000 decisions/episode; no reserved split or external action.
